name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is an advanced-stage silver-gold development company focused on its 100%-owned Diablillos silver-gold project in Salta Province, Argentina. A 2026 Definitive Feasibility Study positions Diablillos among the premier undeveloped silver-gold projects globally, with a CAD$4.2B after-tax NPV and 42% IRR. Early works are underway with first production targeted for end of 2029.
